name: code-terminal
description: 终端模拟器：黑底等宽字 + 提示符
css: #tpl-code-terminal { position: absolute; inset: 10% 9%; background: #0d0d12; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); font-family: 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; overflow: hidden; } #tpl-code-terminal .ct-bar { height: 52px; background: #1c1c24; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 22px; gap: 10px; } #tpl-code-terminal .ct-dot { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; } #tpl-code-terminal .ct-body { padding: 34px 38px; font-size: 32px; line-height: 1.75; color: #3ecf8e; } #tpl-code-terminal .ct-prompt { color: #6d8bff; }
body:
{{prompt}}
{{line1}}
{{line2}}
{{line3}}
